author: raoatifshad
body:
#### PR description:

Fixes the following compiler warnings in `RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp`
```
testEigenJacobian.cpp:72:18: warning: unused variable par2 [-Wunused-variable]
testEigenJacobian.cpp:75:18: warning: unused variable cov2 [-Wunused-variable]
```
These two variables were declared but only used inside an old commented-out block. I removed the variables and the commented-out code, since it is no longer used.
title: Remove unused variables and dead code from testEigenJacobian
